name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: 16px 1px ring. Animation stops when prefers-reduced-motion is on.
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

use: Short waits of unknown length inside a control or a row.
label to say what is loading.

a11y: Renders role="status" with aria-label from label ("Loading" by default); the ring is aria-hidden.
